items.title: Harry Shields Interview, 1961-05-28
items.q: Johnny Riggs is good enough to arrange the interview and his present here too

ctx.x: Let me make a note of the date. This is May the 28th, 1961 and we're over at 731 St. Peter Street interviewing Harry Shields and Johnny Riggs is good enough to arrange the interview and his present here too and this is Bill Russell. Johnny you have something that you want to make

a remark first. Since Harry played with Emmett Hardy so much I'd like to know, there's been a lot of discussion about what style Emmett played in, I'd like to ask Harry what he remembers about his style. He played with Emmett Hardy in Brownlee's band before I joined it and he played with Emmett Hardy I guess maybe more than anybody else in New Orleans. I think he told me
